entities.summary: Arsacid, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Seleucid and Parthian Iran (247 BCE–224). Preceded by Parthian Empire and Parthia and Rome fight repeatedly over Armenia and Mesopotamia. Their legacy influenced Shapur I captures Roman Emperor Valerian at the Battle of Edessa.
